scene: Across the bridge, a bustling transit terrace awaits.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide transit terrace. On the far left, a low wooden barge bobs in a canal. The player, in her lilac headscarf, mustard coat, and brown satchel, stands left of centre. On the right, a glass-roofed trolley sits on tracks. On the far right stands a brass spiral lift.
shown: a wooden river barge moored at a small dock on the far left
a sleek glass-roofed trolley waiting on rails on the right
